name: App con organizaciones, membresías y landing

settings.workspaceSetup: if [ -f orgs-app/package.json ]; then cd orgs-app && pnpm install --ignore-workspace; fi

config.prompt:
We are going to build a new standalone web app in the directory `orgs-app/` at the repository root (it is NOT part of the existing pnpm workspace; always run pnpm there with `--ignore-workspace`). The app has: (1) user auth (email + password), (2) organizations (multi-tenant), (3) organization memberships with roles owner/admin/member and email invitations, (4) a public marketing landing page.

Stack: Next.js (App Router, TypeScript strict), Tailwind CSS, Better Auth with its `organization` plugin, Drizzle ORM with SQLite (better-sqlite3) for local development, Vitest for unit/integration tests, ESLint.

Write a concrete implementation plan, do not write code yet. Include: the folder structure, the data model (users, sessions, organizations, members, invitations), the routes (public landing at `/`, `/login`, `/signup`, `/app` dashboard, `/app/orgs/new`, `/app/orgs/[slug]/members`, `/invite/[token]`), the permission rules per role, which files belong to the 'organizations & memberships' work and which to the 'landing' work (they must not overlap, so they can be built in parallel), and the exact scripts package.json will expose (`dev`, `build`, `test`, `lint`). Invitation emails are only logged to the console (no email provider).

Follow the plan above. Create the base app in `orgs-app/` (standalone, not part of the root pnpm workspace; use `pnpm install --ignore-workspace`). Set up: Next.js App Router + TypeScript strict, Tailwind, ESLint, Vitest, Drizzle + SQLite with the auth schema and migrations, Better Auth with email/password and the `organization` plugin enabled (server config + client), `/login` and `/signup` pages, a protected `/app` layout that redirects to `/login` when there is no session, and a placeholder `/` page. Add a `.env.example` and a README in `orgs-app/` with setup steps. package.json must expose `dev`, `build`, `test` (vitest run) and `lint`. Add at least one test for the auth setup. Do NOT implement organization management UI or the landing content yet. Finish when `pnpm --ignore-workspace install && pnpm test && pnpm lint && pnpm build` pass inside `orgs-app/`.

In the Next.js app in `orgs-app/` (standalone; run pnpm with `--ignore-workspace`), Better Auth with the `organization` plugin and Drizzle/SQLite are already set up. Implement organizations and memberships. Only touch files under `orgs-app/src/app/app/`, `orgs-app/src/app/invite/`, `orgs-app/src/lib/orgs/` and `orgs-app/src/components/orgs/` plus their tests (and the auth/db config only if strictly needed). Do NOT touch the landing page `/` or `orgs-app/src/components/landing/`.

Features:
- `/app`: list the user's organizations and an organization switcher (sets the active organization).
- `/app/orgs/new`: create an organization (name + unique slug); the creator becomes owner.
- `/app/orgs/[slug]/members`: list members with roles; owner/admin can invite by email with a role, change roles and remove members; members can only view; the last owner cannot be removed or demoted; a member can leave the organization.
- Invitations: pending list with cancel; the invite link `/invite/[token]` lets a logged-in user accept or reject (redirect to login/signup first if needed). Log the invite link to the server console instead of sending email.
- Enforce permissions on the server (server actions / route handlers), not only in the UI.

Add Vitest tests for the permission rules and the invitation flow (create, accept, reject, expired/cancelled). Finish when `pnpm test && pnpm lint && pnpm build` pass inside `orgs-app/`.

In the Next.js + Tailwind app in `orgs-app/` (standalone; run pnpm with `--ignore-workspace`), replace the placeholder public page `/` with a polished, responsive marketing landing page for a team collaboration SaaS built around organizations and memberships. Only touch `orgs-app/src/app/page.tsx`, `orgs-app/src/app/(marketing)/` if you need it, and `orgs-app/src/components/landing/`. Do NOT touch `/app`, `/invite`, auth or database code.

Sections: header with logo and links (Features, Pricing, FAQ, Log in, Sign up), hero with a headline and primary CTA to `/signup`, feature grid (organizations, roles & permissions, invitations, security), how it works in 3 steps, pricing with 3 plans (Free, Team, Enterprise; static content, no payments), FAQ (accordion), final CTA and footer. Use semantic HTML, accessible contrast and keyboard-friendly navigation, good metadata (title, description, Open Graph). No external images: use SVG or CSS. Add a Vitest + Testing Library test that renders the page and checks the main sections and the CTA links. Finish when `pnpm test && pnpm lint && pnpm build` pass inside `orgs-app/`.
